## History

During an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, Fred Wright was among the members present when [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announced Judson Parker's plans to rent his fence for patent-medicine advertisements. Later, he formed a romantic relationship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovered the two embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to officially announce their engagement.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright develops a romantic relationship with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). The two become courted and eventually engaged, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finding them embracing in the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) garden. Following this, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) officially announces her engagement to Fred, marking a significant milestone in their relationship.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +3 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting interest  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are comrades within their local community group. They serve together as fellow committee members tasked with canvassing the [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) road on behalf of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)_
